field.label: Log type
field.help: Where query logs are written. Disabled (the default) turns query logging off; Console writes each query to the Blocky log (viewable under Log File); CSV and CSV per-client write daily .log files to /var/db/blocky/querylog; SQLite writes to /var/db/blocky/querylog.db; MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL and TimescaleDB write to a database using the connection string in Target; dnstap streams to the dnstap socket set in Target. Console is high-volume (one line per query); use CSV or a database for long-term logs.

field.label: Target
field.help: Where the log goes, by type. MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB: a connection string, e.g. postgres://user:password@host:5432/blocky. dnstap: tcp://host:port such as tcp://127.0.0.1:6000; Unix sockets are not accepted. A value of file:/usr/local/etc/blocky/secrets/name reads the target from that file, keeping credentials out of the configuration. A connection string can hold a password, so the target is never shown again. Unused for Console, and for CSV and SQLite, which are written to /var/db/blocky/querylog (a 2026-09-14_ALL.log file per day, or one per client) and /var/db/blocky/querylog.db.

field.label: Retention (days)
field.help: Delete query logs older than this many days. 0 keeps them indefinitely. Applies to CSV and the database types; dnstap streams rather than stores.

field.label: Logged fields
field.help: Which fields to record per query. Leave empty to log all fields. Not used by dnstap, which exports the full DNS messages, and log privacy does not obfuscate those payloads.

field.label: Flush interval
field.help: How often buffered entries are written to the target. Used by the database types, which also write as soon as 1,000 entries are waiting, and dnstap; CSV writes each entry as it arrives.

field.label: Creation attempts
field.help: Number of attempts to open the log target before Blocky writes queries to its own log instead. A database that cannot be reached or opened is not given up on: Blocky holds up to about 32 MiB of entries and retries in the background.

field.label: Creation cooldown
field.help: Wait time between attempts to open the log target.

field.label: Ignore SUDN queries
field.help: Do not log queries answered as Special Use Domain Names (SUDN).

field.label: Ignore domains
field.help: Domains excluded from the query log. Each entry matches the query name as an exact domain, a *.wildcard, or a /regex/.

field.label: Ignore clients
field.help: Clients excluded from the query log, such as a router that checks its internet connection every few seconds. Each entry is a client IP address, a CIDR subnet, or a client name, which can use * and ? wildcards. Their queries are still answered, filtered and counted in the metrics.
